stemText: An ideal gas is maintained at constant temperature. If its volume is compressed to one-third of its initial value, its pressure becomes:

solution.explanationText: According to Boyle's law (P V = constant at constant temperature T): P1 V1 = P2 V2 => P2 = P1 (V1 / V2). Since V2 = V1 / 3, P2 = 3 P1. Thus, the pressure becomes three times its initial value.

stemText: According to the kinetic theory of gases, the pressure P exerted by an ideal gas of density rho and root-mean-square velocity v_rms is given by:

solution.explanationText: From the kinetic theory of gases, the pressure exerted by gas molecules on the walls of the container is derived as P = (1/3) * (M_total / V) * v_rms^2 = (1/3) rho v_rms^2.

stemText: The average translational kinetic energy of a molecule of any ideal gas at absolute temperature T depends on:

options.label: A
options.text: The nature and molecular mass of the gas

options.label: B
options.text: Temperature T only and is equal to (3/2) k_B T

options.label: D
options.text: Temperature T only and is equal to (5/2) k_B T

solution.explanationText: The average translational kinetic energy per molecule is given by E_trans = (3/2) k_B T. It is independent of the nature, mass, or atomicity of the gas molecule and depends solely on the absolute temperature T.

translations.stemText: தனி வெப்பநிலை T இல் உள்ள ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு மூலக்கூறின் சராசரி நேரியல் இயக்க ஆற்றல் எதனைச் சார்ந்தது?
optionTexts: வெப்பநிலை T-ஐ மட்டுமே மற்றும் அதன் மதிப்பு (3/2) k_B T
வெப்பநிலை T-ஐ மட்டுமே மற்றும் அதன் மதிப்பு (5/2) k_B T

stemText: For a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution of molecular speeds at a given temperature, the correct order of speeds is:

solution.explanationText: The three characteristic speeds are: Most probable speed v_mp = sqrt(2 R T / M) approx 1.414 sqrt(R T / M); Average speed v_avg = sqrt(8 R T / (pi M)) approx 1.596 sqrt(R T / M); Root-mean-square speed v_rms = sqrt(3 R T / M) approx 1.732 sqrt(R T / M). Thus, v_rms > v_avg > v_mp.

stemText: At moderate temperatures, a rigid diatomic gas molecule has how many degrees of freedom?

solution.explanationText: A rigid diatomic molecule has 3 translational degrees of freedom and 2 rotational degrees of freedom (about two perpendicular axes perpendicular to the internuclear bond). Since vibrational modes are not active at moderate temperatures, the total degrees of freedom is f = 3 + 2 = 5.

stemText: According to the law of equipartition of energy, the average kinetic energy associated with each degree of freedom per molecule in thermal equilibrium at temperature T is:

solution.explanationText: The theorem of equipartition of energy states that in thermal equilibrium, total energy is shared equally among all degrees of freedom, and the average energy associated with each quadratic degree of freedom per molecule is (1/2) k_B T.

translations.stemText: ஆற்றல் சமபங்கீட்டு விதியின்படி, T வெப்பநிலையில் வெப்பச் சமநிலையில் உள்ள ஒரு மூலக்கூறின் ஒவ்வொரு சுதந்திர இயக்கக் கூறுடனும் தொடர்புடைய சராசரி இயக்க ஆற்றல்:

stemText: If E is the translational kinetic energy per unit volume of an ideal gas, the pressure P exerted by the gas is related to E as:

solution.explanationText: Pressure is P = (1/3) rho v_rms^2. Kinetic energy per unit volume is E = (1/2) rho v_rms^2 => rho v_rms^2 = 2 E. Substituting this gives P = (1/3) * (2 E) = (2/3) E.

translations.stemText: E என்பது ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயுவின் ஓரலகு பருமனுக்கான நேரியல் இயக்க ஆற்றல் எனில், வாயு ஏற்படுத்தும் அழுத்தம் P ஆனது E உடன் எவ்வாறு தொடர்புடையது?

stemText: The mean free path lambda of molecules of an ideal gas is related to absolute temperature T and pressure P as:

solution.explanationText: The mean free path is lambda = 1 / (sqrt(2) n pi d^2). From the ideal gas equation P = n k_B T, the number density is n = P / (k_B T). Substituting n gives lambda = (k_B T) / (sqrt(2) pi d^2 P). Thus, lambda is proportional to T / P.

translations.stemText: ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு மூலக்கூறுகளின் சராசரி மோதல் இடைவெளி lambda ஆனது தனி வெப்பநிலை T மற்றும் அழுத்தம் P ஆகியவற்றுடன் எவ்வாறு தொடர்புடையது?

stemText: If the absolute temperature of an ideal gas is quadrupled (T' = 4T) at constant volume, the collision frequency of the gas molecules will:

solution.explanationText: Collision frequency is nu = v_avg / lambda. The mean free path is lambda = 1 / (sqrt(2) n pi d^2). At constant volume, number density n is constant, so lambda remains constant. The average speed is v_avg proportional to sqrt(T). Therefore, nu is proportional to sqrt(T). When T becomes 4T, nu becomes sqrt(4) = 2 times its initial value.

stemText: The Moon has no atmosphere primarily because:

options.label: A
options.text: The escape speed on the Moon is smaller than the root-mean-square speed of gas molecules

options.label: B
options.text: The gravitational pull of the Sun sweeps away all gases

options.label: C
options.text: The temperature on the Moon is extremely low

options.label: D
options.text: Gases react chemically with the lunar rocks

solution.explanationText: The acceleration due to gravity on the Moon is small, making the escape speed from its surface low (approx 2.38 km/s). At lunar daytime temperatures, the root-mean-square speed of light gas molecules (like H2, He, O2) exceeds or is comparable to the lunar escape velocity, causing them to escape into space.

stemText: As the absolute temperature of an ideal gas increases, the peak of the Maxwell-Boltzmann molecular speed distribution curve:

options.label: A
options.text: Shifts to the right and becomes taller

options.label: B
options.text: Shifts to the right and flattens (becomes lower)

options.label: C
options.text: Shifts to the left and becomes taller

options.label: D
options.text: Remains at the same position but broadens

solution.explanationText: The peak of the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution corresponds to the most probable speed v_mp = sqrt(2 k_B T / m), which increases with temperature, shifting the peak to the right (higher speed). Since the total area under the probability distribution must remain normalized to unity, the peak height decreases, causing the curve to flatten and broaden.

stemText: At very high temperatures, when the vibrational mode of a diatomic molecule is also active, the molar heat capacity at constant volume C_v is:

solution.explanationText: At high temperatures, a diatomic molecule has 3 translational, 2 rotational, and 1 vibrational mode. A vibrational mode contributes 2 degrees of freedom (one kinetic energy term and one potential energy term). Thus, total degrees of freedom is f = 3 + 2 + 2 = 7. Consequently, C_v = (f/2) R = (7/2) R.

stemText: An open rigid vessel contains air at 27 degree Celsius. To what temperature must it be heated so that one-third of the air initially inside the vessel escapes into the atmosphere?

solution.explanationText: Because the vessel is open, pressure P and volume V remain constant, which means n * T = constant. If n is the initial number of moles, the remaining moles inside the vessel is n' = n - n/3 = (2/3) n. Thus, n * T1 = n' * T2 => n * (27 + 273) = (2/3) n * T2 => 300 = (2/3) T2 => T2 = 300 * 3 / 2 = 450 K. In Celsius: t2 = 450 - 273 = 177 degree Celsius.

translations.stemText: ஒரு திறந்த திடமான கலனில் 27 degree Celsius வெப்பநிலையில் காற்று உள்ளது. கலனில் உள்ள காற்றின் மூன்றில் ஒரு பங்கு வளிமண்டலத்திற்கு வெளியேறும் வகையில் அது எந்த வெப்பநிலைக்கு சூடேற்றப்பட வேண்டும்?

stemText: Under identical conditions of temperature and pressure, the rate of diffusion of gas A is 4 times that of gas B. The ratio of the molecular mass of gas A to that of gas B is:

solution.explanationText: According to Graham's law of diffusion, rate of diffusion r is inversely proportional to the square root of molar mass: r proportional to 1 / sqrt(M). Thus, r_A / r_B = sqrt(M_B / M_A) => 4 = sqrt(M_B / M_A) => M_B / M_A = 16 => M_A / M_B = 1 / 16.

translations.stemText: ஒரே வெப்பநிலை மற்றும் அழுத்த நிபந்தனைகளில், வாயு A இன் விரவல் வீதம் வாயு B இன் விரவல் வீதத்தைப் போல 4 மடங்கு ஆகும். வாயு A மற்றும் வாயு B ஆகியவற்றின் மூலக்கூறு நிறைகளின் விகிதம்:

stemText: An ideal gas is expanded adiabatically according to P V^(5/3) = constant. During this expansion, the mean free path lambda of the gas molecules varies with volume V as:

solution.explanationText: Mean free path is lambda = 1 / (sqrt(2) n pi d^2). The number density of molecules is n = N / V, where N is the total number of molecules in volume V. Substituting n gives lambda = V / (sqrt(2) N pi d^2). Therefore, the mean free path depends purely on the volume V of the container (directly proportional to V) and is completely independent of temperature, pressure, or the nature of the thermodynamic process.

stemText: For an ideal gas consisting of non-linear triatomic molecules (such as water vapor H2O) at room temperature, neglecting vibrational modes, the ratio of molar heat capacities gamma = C_p / C_v is:

solution.explanationText: A non-linear triatomic molecule has 3 translational degrees of freedom and 3 rotational degrees of freedom (rotation about all three Cartesian axes). Total degrees of freedom f = 3 + 3 = 6. Thus, C_v = (6/2) R = 3 R, and C_p = C_v + R = 3 R + R = 4 R. The ratio is gamma = C_p / C_v = 4R / 3R = 4/3.

stemText: In an ideal gas of adiabatic index gamma, the ratio of the root-mean-square speed of gas molecules v_rms to the speed of sound v_s in the same gas is:

solution.explanationText: The root-mean-square speed of molecules is v_rms = sqrt(3 R T / M). The speed of sound in an ideal gas is v_s = sqrt(gamma R T / M). Taking their ratio gives v_rms / v_s = [sqrt(3 R T / M)] / [sqrt(gamma R T / M)] = sqrt(3 / gamma).

translations.stemText: வெப்பப் பரிமாற்றமில்லா அடுக்கு gamma கொண்ட ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயுவில், வாயு மூலக்கூறுகளின் சராசரி இருமடி மூல வேகம் v_rms க்கும் அதே வாயுவில் ஒலியின் வேகம் v_s க்கும் உள்ள விகிதம்:

stemText: n1 moles of an ideal gas at absolute temperature T1 is mixed adiabatically with n2 moles of another ideal gas at temperature T2. If the molar heat capacities at constant volume of the two gases are C_v1 and C_v2 respectively, the final equilibrium temperature T of the mixture is:

options.label: A
options.text: (n1 C_v1 T1 + n2 C_v2 T2) / (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2)

options.label: C
options.text: (n1 C_v2 T1 + n2 C_v1 T2) / (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2)

solution.explanationText: Because the mixing is adiabatic and no external work is done, total internal energy is conserved: U_initial = U_final. Here U1 + U2 = U_mix => n1 C_v1 T1 + n2 C_v2 T2 = (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2) T. Solving for the equilibrium temperature yields T = (n1 C_v1 T1 + n2 C_v2 T2) / (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2).

optionTexts: (n1 C_v1 T1 + n2 C_v2 T2) / (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2)
(n1 C_v2 T1 + n2 C_v1 T2) / (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2)

stemText: The rate of molecular collisions per unit area with the planar wall of a container holding an ideal gas of number density n and average speed v_avg is:

solution.explanationText: By integrating over all velocities directed towards the wall across hemispherical solid angles, the flux of molecules striking a unit area of the wall per second is derived in kinetic theory as J = (1/4) n v_avg.

stemText: The root-mean-square speed of gas molecules at 27 degree Celsius is v0. To double this root-mean-square speed (2 v0), the temperature of the gas must be raised to _____ K.

solution.explanationText: The rms speed is v_rms = sqrt(3 R T / M) proportional to sqrt(T). Initial temperature is T1 = 27 + 273 = 300 K. For the rms speed to double: v2 / v1 = 2 = sqrt(T2 / T1) => T2 / T1 = 4 => T2 = 4 * 300 K = 1200 K.

translations.stemText: 27 degree Celsius வெப்பநிலையில் வாயு மூலக்கூறுகளின் சராசரி இருமடி மூல வேகம் v0 ஆகும். இந்த rms வேகத்தை இருமடங்காக மாற்ற (2 v0), வாயுவின் வெப்பநிலை _____ K ஆக உயர்த்தப்பட வேண்டும்.

stemText: The total internal energy of 2 moles of an ideal monoatomic gas at an absolute temperature of 300 K is expressed as N * R Joules, where R is the universal gas constant. Find the value of N.

solution.explanationText: The internal energy of an ideal monoatomic gas is given by U = n C_v T = n * ((3/2) R) * T. Substituting n = 2 moles and T = 300 K: U = 2 * ((3/2) R) * 300 = 3 R * 300 = 900 R Joules. Thus, N = 900.

stemText: The total number of translational degrees of freedom possessed by 4 moles of an ideal gas is N * N_A, where N_A is Avogadro's number. Find the integer value of N.

solution.explanationText: Every gas molecule, regardless of whether it is monoatomic, diatomic, or polyatomic, has exactly 3 translational degrees of freedom (motion along x, y, and z axes). Therefore, for 4 moles of gas containing 4 N_A molecules, the total number of translational degrees of freedom is 3 * 4 N_A = 12 N_A. Thus, N = 12.

stemText: The root-mean-square speed of hydrogen molecules (molar mass = 2 g/mol) at 25 K is equal to the root-mean-square speed of oxygen molecules (molar mass = 32 g/mol) at temperature T. The value of T is _____ K.

solution.explanationText: The rms speed of a gas is v_rms = sqrt(3 R T / M). Equating the rms speeds: sqrt(3 R T_H2 / M_H2) = sqrt(3 R T_O2 / M_O2) => T_H2 / M_H2 = T_O2 / M_O2. Substituting T_H2 = 25 K, M_H2 = 2 g/mol, and M_O2 = 32 g/mol: 25 / 2 = T_O2 / 32 => T_O2 = 25 * 16 = 400 K.

translations.stemText: 25 K வெப்பநிலையில் ஹைட்ரஜன் மூலக்கூறுகளின் (மோலார் நிறை = 2 g/mol) சராசரி இருமடி மூல வேகம், T வெப்பநிலையில் உள்ள ஆக்சிஜன் மூலக்கூறுகளின் (மோலார் நிறை = 32 g/mol) rms வேகத்திற்குச் சமம் எனில், T இன் மதிப்பு _____ K.

stemText: An ideal gas in a container is heated and compressed such that its absolute temperature is quadrupled (4T) while its pressure is doubled (2P). The ratio of the new mean free path to the initial mean free path of the gas molecules is _____.

solution.explanationText: The mean free path of an ideal gas is lambda = (k_B T) / (sqrt(2) pi d^2 P) proportional to T / P. Therefore: lambda_new / lambda_initial = (T_new / T_initial) * (P_initial / P_new) = (4) * (1 / 2) = 2.

translations.stemText: ஒரு கொள்கலனில் உள்ள நல்லியல்பு வாயுவானது அதன் தனி வெப்பநிலை நான்கு மடங்காகவும் (4T), அழுத்தம் இருமடங்காகவும் (2P) மாறும் வகையில் சூடேற்றப்பட்டு அமுக்கப்படுகிறது. வாயு மூலக்கூறுகளின் புதிய சராசரி மோதல் இடைவெளிக்கும் ஆரம்ப சராசரி மோதல் இடைவெளிக்கும் உள்ள விகிதம் _____.

stemText: Two moles of an ideal diatomic gas undergo an adiabatic expansion in which the gas performs 100 * R Joules of work on the surroundings (where R is the universal gas constant). The magnitude of the decrease in temperature of the gas is _____ K.

solution.explanationText: For an adiabatic process, heat exchange is Delta Q = 0. According to the First Law: W = - Delta U = - n C_v Delta T. For an ideal diatomic gas, C_v = (5/2) R. Therefore: 100 R = - 2 * ((5/2) R) * Delta T = - 5 R * Delta T => Delta T = - 100 / 5 = -20 K. The magnitude of the decrease in temperature is 20 K.

translations.stemText: இரண்டு மோல்கள் கொண்ட ஒரு நல்லியல்பு ஈரணு வாயு வெப்பப் பரிமாற்றமில்லா விரிவடைதலுக்கு உட்பட்டு சூழ்நிலையின் மீது 100 * R ஜூல் வேலையைச் செய்கிறது (R என்பது பொது வாயு மாறிலி). வாயுவின் வெப்பநிலையில் ஏற்படும் குறைவின் எண்மதிப்பு _____ K.

stemText: A sample of gas is heated from an initial temperature of 300 K to a final temperature of 900 K. The ratio of the average translational kinetic energy per molecule at the final temperature to that at the initial temperature is _____.

solution.explanationText: The average translational kinetic energy per molecule of an ideal gas is E = (3/2) k_B T, which is directly proportional to absolute temperature T. Therefore, E_final / E_initial = T_final / T_initial = 900 K / 300 K = 3.

translations.stemText: ஒரு வாயு மாதிரி 300 K ஆரம்ப வெப்பநிலையிலிருந்து 900 K இறுதி வெப்பநிலைக்கு சூடேற்றப்படுகிறது. இறுதி வெப்பநிலையில் ஒரு மூலக்கூறின் சராசரி நேரியல் இயக்க ஆற்றலுக்கும் ஆரம்ப வெப்பநிலையில் உள்ளதற்கும் இடையேயான விகிதம் _____.

stemText: A gas mixture contains 1 mole of an ideal monoatomic gas and 2 moles of an ideal rigid diatomic gas. The total number of degrees of freedom of all molecules in the mixture is N * N_A, where N_A is Avogadro's number. Find the integer value of N.

solution.explanationText: A monoatomic molecule has 3 degrees of freedom. For 1 mole, degrees of freedom = 1 * 3 N_A = 3 N_A. A rigid diatomic molecule has 5 degrees of freedom. For 2 moles, degrees of freedom = 2 * 5 N_A = 10 N_A. The total number of degrees of freedom in the mixture is 3 N_A + 10 N_A = 13 N_A. Hence, N = 13.

stemText: In a comparative study of two ideal gases A and B, the effective molecular diameter of gas A is twice that of gas B (d_A = 2 d_B), and the number density of molecules of gas A is twice that of gas B (n_A = 2 n_B). The ratio of the mean free path of molecules of gas B to that of gas A (lambda_B / lambda_A) is _____.

solution.explanationText: The mean free path of gas molecules is given by lambda = 1 / (sqrt(2) n pi d^2). Therefore, lambda is inversely proportional to n * d^2. The ratio of their mean free paths is lambda_B / lambda_A = (n_A / n_B) * (d_A / d_B)^2. Substituting n_A / n_B = 2 and d_A / d_B = 2: lambda_B / lambda_A = (2) * (2)^2 = 2 * 4 = 8.

translations.stemText: A மற்றும் B என்ற இரு நல்லியல்பு வாயுக்களின் ஒப்பீட்டு ஆய்வில், வாயு A இன் மூலக்கூறு விட்டம் வாயு B-ஐப் போல இருமடங்கு (d_A = 2 d_B), மற்றும் வாயு A இன் மூலக்கூறு எண் அடர்த்தி வாயு B-ஐப் போல இருமடங்கு (n_A = 2 n_B). வாயு B இன் சராசரி மோதல் இடைவெளிக்கும் வாயு A இன் சராசரி மோதல் இடைவெளிக்கும் உள்ள விகிதம் (lambda_B / lambda_A) _____.

stemText: An ideal gas kept at a constant temperature is compressed isothermally such that its volume is reduced to one-half of its initial volume. According to the kinetic theory of gases, the total rate of intermolecular collisions occurring per unit volume of the gas increases by a factor of _____.

solution.explanationText: The total rate of binary molecular collisions per unit volume is given by Z_11 = (1/2) * sqrt(2) * pi * d^2 * v_avg * n^2, where n is the number density of molecules and v_avg is the average molecular speed. Since the compression is isothermal, the temperature T remains constant, so v_avg = sqrt(8 k_B T / (pi m)) is constant. When volume is halved (V' = V / 2), the number density doubles (n' = 2n). Therefore, the collision rate per unit volume scales as n^2: Z_11' / Z_11 = (n' / n)^2 = (2)^2 = 4.

translations.stemText: மாறா வெப்பநிலையில் உள்ள ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயுவானது அதன் பருமன் தொடக்க பருமனில் பாதியாக குறையும் வகையில் சமவெப்ப நிலையில் அமுக்கப்படுகிறது. வாயுக்களின் இயக்கவியல் கொள்கையின்படி, வாயுவின் ஓரலகு பருமனில் நிகழும் மொத்த மூலக்கூறிடை மோதல்களின் வீதம் எத்தனை மடங்கு அதிகரிக்கும்?
